profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and creative strategist. Passionate about small businesses and sole proprietors. Firm believer that lean tech and clever engineering can make a major impact in any industry. Six years experience as a full stack engineer and cloud solutions specialist.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Championed core infrastructure capability from POC stage to production, enabling new optimization models to execute daily for hundreds of vendors and tens of thousands of SKU’s of both core and pharmaceutical inventory
    • Maintained and iterated on a fault-tolerant orchestration product supporting the scheduled execution of business critical models, handling hundreds of gigabytes of data daily in a distributed framework
    • Provided tailored support to Data Scientists, Analysts, Product Managers, Engineers, and external teams for user onboarding, product adoption, feedback gathering, and new use case identification

positions.title: Founder, Manager
positions.description:
- Founded a software consulting company that developed software and guided software projects for several startups and small businesses

- Independently secured three contracts within the first year of business, made $25k in revenue
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Bootstrapping · Microservices · DevOps · Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Start-up Consulting · New Business Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created risk analysis dashboard using React and Flask allowing tens of businesses to monitor transaction risk for a given crypto address

- Architected serverless ongoing monitoring system using AWS Lambda and EventBridge providing daily risk comprehension of 350 GB of customer data at subsecond query times; stored using AWS Aurora

- Data acquisition and web scraping using python to parse OFAC Sanctions lists, Bash scripts using cURL for open source data, Java and Jung for on-chain graph analysis, and AWS S3 for storage; 100,000 addresses scanned per day, all orchestrated using Apache Airflow
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Cryptocurrency · React.js · Apache Airflow · Flask · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · JavaScript · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed mobile and desktop SPA’s using React/React Native and Flask to connect cancer patient data to clinicians

- Used PIL and AWS Rekognition for image processing to recognize food with 95% accuracy and query USDA API to provide accurate nutritional breakdowns for clinical use

- Deployed Microservice architecture to several EC2 Servers using NGINX + Gunicorn and systemd to ensure high availability and throughput
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Team Leadership · Microservices · Flask · Databases · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built CRM Dashboard using React and Express to connect 300+ customers to company resources

- Created custom communications analytics using AWS Lambda and Eventbridge allowing managers to see overview statistics of email and web campaigns

- Designed and implemented customer login system to authenticate users throughout our microservices using AWS Cognito
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · Node.js · Amazon Cognito · React.js · Amazon EC2 · SQL · Express.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Led teams of high school students in curriculum based competition. Built upon pre-existing curriculum and developed lesson plans to teach various operating systems, networking tools, and hardware management.
positions.insights: Skills: Student Counseling · Computer Repair · Linux · Kali Linux · Bash · Teaching · Ethical Hacking

positions.title: Lead Facilitator
positions.description: Observed and led STEM oriented activities designed to promote physical, mental, and social capabilities. Evaluated over 100+ children over multiple school districts. Provided introduction to engineering interests to school without STEM programs

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas
